annotations.title: Buy a Research Pass with a plain USDC transfer: get a quote (free)

description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote and the USDC amount to send on Base to this service. After sending, call pass_claim with the quote and the transaction hash to receive the pass token.

from.description: Optional: the Base address you will pay from (0x + 40 hex). With it you pay a round amount; without it you must send the exact odd amount quoted.

plan.description: day = 24 hours, up to 40 calls, $1; week = 7 days, up to 300 calls, $5. Default day.
